title: The first episode of "Paranormal Prison" features Motionless In White
excerpt: Motionless in White guitarist Ricky Olson and drummer Vinny Mauro kicked off Season 4 of Paranormal Prison.
content:
Silvio Colombo

Author Benedetta Baldin - 26.9.2026

Motionless In White guitarist Ricky Olson and drummer Vinny Mauro kicked off Season 4 of Paranormal Prison, joining hosts Josh Bernstein (The Power Hour, Z2) and Katrina Weidman (Portals to Hell) for an investigation of one of the world’s most notorious correctional facilities, as per Loudwire. Filmed during the 2026 Inkcarceration Music & Tattoo Festival—a Danny Wimmer Presents event hosted at the historic Ohio State Reformatory in Mansfield, Ohio—the series pairs true believers with skeptics using advanced paranormal investigation equipment.

The episode opens in the facility’s decaying “toilet room,” an abandoned area filled with dirt-caked commodes and discarded furniture. As Weidman introduced the spirit box—a device engineered to detect spiritual interference across radio frequencies—Olson noted his prior experience with the tool during personal investigations with his girlfriend. Olson shared that he frequently achieves results with the device, observing that spirit responses often pivot away from direct questions to steer the conversation elsewhere.

As the investigation inside the Ohio State Reformatory progressed, the team picked up several clear phrases through the spirit box, including “relationship,” “stay in the next room,” “…that I’m here,” and “Oh, they’re coming.” When drummer Vinny Mauro—an admitted skeptic—asked if the spirits were comfortable with their presence, the device yielded a negative response that noticeably rattled him.

Later in the segment, guitarist Ricky Olson shared the childhood origin of his interest in the supernatural, recalling how seeing a young boy in his bedroom at age seven or eight sparked his lifelong fascination with the paranormal.

When I was 7 or 8 years old, I woke up to a little boy in my room. It scared the life out of me.

The session culminated with the team capturing visual anomalies floating between Olson and Mauro, while a voice through the spirit box explicitly confirmed, “I’m with you.”
